notes.title: 🛠 Patch #3: UI Polishing, Bug Fixes & Tutorial Improvements
notes.notes:
Ping! This is Shi.  
Warden, patch 3 is now deployed. This update focuses on visual polish and system stability. Several key changes will significantly improve your field operations.

📘 Tutorial & UX Improvements:

Improved tutorial guidance for the “Escape” mechanic: now includes clearer info and a prompt before action.
After escaping a mission, the game will now auto-load from the most recent autosave to let you retry smoothly.  
The “Skip Day” button is now highlighted in the tutorial after Mission 1-1.  
Tutorial upgraded for better clarity on item management.  

🛠 Gameplay & Interface Fixes:

Double-squad missions now process correctly, no more missing second screen.  
Effect icons now display correctly in skill tooltips.  
UI buttons now reset properly when using the Back option in settings.  
Hover text for base modules reorganized for better clarity.  
Combat system and HP logic slightly adjusted for improved story mode pacing.  
Minor bug fixes, including resolving rare cursor disappearance issues.  

🌍 Localization Updates:

Added Indonesian and Portuguese (AI-translated; subject to revision). If you want to help us with the translation into your language, please contact us via Steam discussions or Discord. 
Survey links now correlate with your chosen language.  

Play now and check it out! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1396540/Twilight_Wars
We’re deeply grateful for your support! We read everything and are always open to more suggestions.  
Keep sending signals, Warden.

Join us on social media for more news and updates:
🤖 Discord
🤖 Twitter/X
🤖 Bluesky

See you at the “Triple-A” base.
– Shi

notes.title: 🛠 Patch #2 – Difficulty Adjustments & Quality of Life Improvements.
notes.notes:
Ping! This is Shi.  
Warden, field conditions evolve – and so must we. This update brings new tactical options for both seasoned operatives and those just entering the shadows.

🟢 New Difficulty: “Easy” Mode  
A new difficulty setting has been added for players who wish to focus more on the story and atmosphere of Twilight Wars, without the pressure of brutal encounters.


Agents have more health and deal increased damage.  
The Agency starts with a larger amount of money, allowing you to “skip days” more freely to recover agent health and morale.  
Designed for a relaxed experience. Combat is still tactical, but the heat is turned down.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40261456/3ac178a0d51c24965093bebb7002be24fdee4266.png

⚙️ Adjustments to “Recommended” Mode  

Enemies no longer deal devastating critical hits.  
Starting funds have been increased, making day-skipping for recovery more accessible.  

Please note: to access these changes, you’ll need to start a new game and select the mode you wish to play in during the initial setup. It does not apply retroactively to existing save files.

⏩ Additional Settings  
New speed-up options are now available to those who’ve made themselves familiar with the base, and really, really hate to wait:

Combat animations  
Message popups in the in-game messenger  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40261456/d24eaca68224193fca09ed3882ec299e67a7ea35.jpg

These will be especially useful for Warden-level operatives who’ve already spent several hours in the field and wish to streamline the routine.

🔧 Localization Fixes  

A number of localization issues have been corrected based on community feedback.  

Play now and check it out! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1396540/Twilight_Wars
Your feedback is critical to our mission.  
We read every message and every review, and your input is already shaping future updates.  
More improvements are planned, and we’ll share details with you soon.

Join us on social media for more news and updates:
🤖 Discord
🤖 Twitter/X
🤖 Bluesky

See you at the “Triple-A” base.
– Shi

notes.title: 🛠 Patch #1 – New Mode Added: No More Misses!
notes.notes:
Ping! This is Shi.  
Warden, I’ve analyzed your field reports, and adjustments have been deployed.

🟢 New Difficulty: “Recommended” Mode  
This new mode is ideal for players who prefer a more forgiving experience without sacrificing tactical depth.

Key features of “Recommended” mode:  
• Agents will not miss attacks, unless the enemy has evasion abilities or the skill is used from a weak position.  
• You can replay individual rooms in a mission using the most recent autosave.  
• After failing or escaping, you can retry the mission entirely.

notes.title: Update Deployed: New Twilight Wars Playtest Version Now Live
notes.notes:
Ping, Warden.

Your feedback has been invaluable. We’ve read every report, studied every comment, and integrated your insights to make Twilight Wars a better, sharper experience. The full release is near, but first, we’d love to share an update to our playtest build.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40261456/59e262c0f26b166b7e6170967b45e13b50495115.png

This version reflects your voice. We’ve adjusted mechanics, refined systems, and added features directly inspired by your input. Now, we need you again: dive in, test everything, break what you can — and then tell us all about it. Your insights are how this game evolves.

Drop your thoughts in the in-game feedback form or on our Discord. Every message counts.

How to Join the Playtest
Just head to our Steam page, click “Request Access”, and you’re in.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1396540/Twilight_Wars/

The feedback form opens automatically after you close the game. This only applies to the playtest build, as we need all the input we can get. It won’t be included in the final version!

🧠 What’s New – Based on Your Feedback

As requested, we made the in-game random events smarter – now you'll face less unfair outcomes!
Steam Status Display
Agent and Enemy Balance Tweaks
Module and Upgrade Cost Adjustments
Module Bonus Recalibration
Energy System Rework
Drone Overhaul: The Drone can now receive and apply buffs to your squad, its upgrades are rebalanced, and repair cost is reduced.
Warden Skill Bonuses Refined
Morale System Overhaul
Wound System Tweaks
Psycho Perk Behavior Changes
Reworked Tutorial
Skip Buttons for Cinematics and Loading Screens
Improved Combat and Group Chat Logs
Cosmetic Updates
Bug Fixes & Minor Optimizations

Note: We want to let you know that your saves from a previous version of the build might not carry over to this one. Thank you for your patience and continued support as we keep refining the game.

This build is not just a test — it’s a milestone. And your continued support is what powers this Agency forward. We’re counting on your voice! Let us know what works, what doesn’t, and what still needs to be cracked. 

Share your thoughts with us, it’s the intel we rely on. 
Join us on social media for more news and updates!  
🤖 Discord  
🤖 Twitter/X  
🤖 Bluesky  
Your analysis is vital.  
See you at the “Triple-A” base!

notes.title: 🤖 Twilight Wars Release Date Confirmed — May 23!
notes.notes:
Ping! This is Shi.
The time has come to mark your calendar — Twilight Wars will officially launch on May 23, 2025. Our shared mission to restore the "Triple-A" enters its most critical phase.
[previewyoutube=k5kkkGnYTvU;full][/previewyoutube]
🖋️ A Personal Note from Shi:
Warden, none of this would have been possible without your vigilance, your feedback, and your belief in the mission. Your support has strengthened the Agency through every setback and breakthrough. As we approach the final operation, I trust you will stand with us once more — and carry Twilight Wars across the threshold into release. Together, we are unstoppable.

If you haven't yet, be sure to add Twilight Wars to your wishlist and follow the project. Your support increases the Agency’s operational reach.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1396540/Twilight_Wars/ 
In the neon-lit, corporate-dominated world of Twilight Wars, it’s up to you to rebuild what was lost. Recruit agents, lead high-stakes missions, and navigate the fragile bonds within your team. Every operation matters!

🛡️ About Twilight Wars:

Tactical Espionage Combat: Action-packed dungeon crawling with turn-based combat set in a high-stakes cyberpunk world. Features a fresh twist on “permadeath” where agents can fall — but not always forever.
A team with real personalities: Each agent has fears, conflicts, and quirks that can shift the tides of battle. Build trust, manage clashes — or watch your squad fall apart.
Diverse missions, countless strategies: Rescue hostages, launch assaults, gather intel, or strategically retreat. No two campaigns are the same.
A cozy base to call home: Heal your wounded, revive fallen comrades, and develop cutting-edge tech modules. (And don’t forget to feed the cat. 🐾)
Morality in the Machine: Shape the story through your choices and your evolving relationship with Shi, the Agency’s AI. Navigate moral dilemmas that lead to multiple narrative endings.
Cozy Cyberpunk Aesthetic: A unique visual and musical style that fuses gritty neon dystopia with a surprisingly warm, lived-in vibe — welcome to the world of "cozy cyberpunk."

📢 Playtest Reminder:
The Playtest is still ongoing on Steam! If you want to get an early glimpse of Agency life — and help us fine-tune the final experience — join the Playtest today.

Join us on social media for more news and updates:
🤖 Discord

Your analysis is vital.
See you at the “Triple-A” base.
– Shi

notes.title: Global Update of the Twilight Wars Demo!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40261456/a53f32261a86d17bac50731c578e05148257f514.png
Ping! This is Shi, the AI speaking. Since the release of the previous demo, many changes have occurred at the agency, and the reason for them is you — our Wardens, and your invaluable feedback: reviews, forum discussions, and survey results.

These innovations will fully unfold in the release version of the game, which is in active development, but you can already check out our progress by playing the updated Declassified 2.1 demo during the Steam Turn-Based RPG Fest.

Play now! Download the demo from the Twilight Wars game page using the "Download demo" button!

Here's a report so you don't miss anything interesting:

[Tutorial]

 The tutorial for the missions and the Base has been updated. It now provides clearer and more detailed explanations of the game's core mechanics.
 Loading screens with tactical tips have been added to teach you various gameplay intricacies.

[Visuals]

 Improved status effect animations on characters, such as burning, poisoning, stunning, and more.
 Added animations on the screen during status effects to enhance the combat dynamics.
 Added various color schemes for enemies.
 Character death animations have been updated.
 The Region Map has been improved.

[Interface]

 Tooltips for abilities and characters have been refined. They are now more informative, with dynamic parameters and concise descriptions.
 Improved targeting reticles. Now, when selecting a target, information about the expected damage, status effects, and their effectiveness is displayed.
 Due to popular demand, fonts are now LARGER.

[Combat System]

 A detailed combat log has been added, making it easier to follow what's happening during missions. The log includes not only characters' actions and abilities but also key plot dialogues.
 A positive effect has been added when agents change positions, depending on their role.
 Enemy AI has been improved. They will now push you to adapt to combat situations and think through tactics more carefully.
 The Psychoperks system has been implemented — psychological traits of agents that provide penalties, bonuses, or more unusual and ambiguous effects.
 A new consumable item, the Neurotonic, has been added. It helps maintain agents' mental health. High morale not only makes them more accurate, agile, and loyal but also increases the chance of gaining a useful psychoperk.
 The Injury System has been implemented. When retreating or after completing a mission, agents can now sustain injuries. These come in varying severity, affecting the maximum health pool and can be treated in the updated Infirmary module.
 The Worldviews and Relationships system has been implemented, directly impacting the effectiveness of your squad. Agents with friendly relations will go on missions with high morale, while those with conflicting worldviews will suffer. You’ll feel the full pain of clashing worldviews during the first mission with the Kunoichi agent.
 Some enemies now have resistances to effects. For example, the gas mask-wearing rat is now resistant to poison.

[Balance]

 Many character abilities and the leveling system have been reworked. We have meticulously balanced the difficulty, and we hope that creating your own squad combinations and battling will be even more exciting!
 Adjusted consumable prices, mission rewards, and agent salaries.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40261456/a858de18a6b59583563da42d33397c56da88837c.gif
[ Sound Design ]

 The combat and base music themes have been changed. Combat music is now more dynamic, while the base music is more relaxing. A variety of original soundtracks have been composed, which we hope will help immerse you in the cozy cyberpunk atmosphere.
 Improved battle sounds, such as "pain screams" when agents or enemies get hit. These screams were recorded by our team members, as well as our friends and family.
 The Radiostalker text quest has been refined.

[Base]

 You can now dismiss agents who, in your opinion, are not suited for working with "Triple-A." But use this extreme measure with caution — each character has a unique quest and personal dialogues that will become unavailable after dismissal.
 A "Biography" tab has been added to the agent profiles, where you can read the backstory of your favorite hero, better understand their personality, and motivations in the fight against corporations. Over time, new details will be added, revealing aspects of the character’s past or their development throughout the story.
 News has been added, reflecting the impact of your actions on the world. But don’t think everything revolves around "Triple-A" — the news will also cover events happening around the globe, independent of your involvement.
 A Group Chat has been added to the Messenger with agent comments and a detailed mission report, as well as base events such as module construction, changes in agent loyalty and morale, level-ups, psychoperks, and much more — perfect for those who focus more on the tactical aspect.
 In the demo, you will now have the opportunity to build a Columbarium — a module that allows you to resurrect a fallen agent using a digitized copy of their personality.
 The Relationship system between agents and the Watcher has been implemented. If agents' views differ from yours, they will receive the "Antagonism" psychoperk, and their loyalty to the organization will decrease.
 A music player has been added. The collection will grow as you progress through the game, but to gather all the tracks, you'll need to explore the map thoroughly during missions.

[Narrative]

 The demo now includes a new interview and private dialogue with agent Needle, which serves as a request for a personal mission.
 A new cutscene has been added and voiced, telling the story of corporate liberation and the rise of "Triple-A" as the sole opposing force.
 Text-based character reactions have been added to emphasize their personalities. In combat, they will comment on successful or failed shots, the death of enemies or allies, and more. At the base, they will share their opinions on various events, from module installations to hiring new staff.
 The narrative scene in the tutorial mission has been improved.

[Miscellaneous]

 Localization system reworked.
 Game graphics settings have been reworked.
 Numerous bugs and glitches have been fixed.
 Game resources have been optimized for faster load times.


Thank you for supporting us, and please continue to share your thoughts through the in-game survey, available in the main menu, to help us improve.

See you at the "Triple-A" base!
